newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIAN INKOMBANK SAYS TO ISSUE $500 MLN EUROBONDS.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIAN INKOMBANK SAYS TO ISSUE $500 MLN EUROBONDS.

text.p: AB Inkombank, Russia's fourth biggest bank by assets, said on Friday it planned to issue a total of $500 million Eurobonds, with the first $200 million issue to be launched in November.

"Now we are working on the programme of placing Eurobonds on international markets and plan to enter the market with the paper in November," Vice President Dmitry Amvrosiyev told journalists. When asked how much the bank planned to issue, he said the total volume would be $500 million with the first issue amounting to $200 million.
